q2.pergunta: What information does UFLA collect and how is it used?
q2.resposta: UFLA collects basic information such as name, course, year of completion, and contact details, as well as information about your professional trajectory. This data is used to keep the alumni network active and support the improvement of the institution's course quality. For more information on this subject, access the Personal Data Use Consent Term, available on the PLAEG alumni platform.

q3.pergunta: Who can register on the PLAEG alumni platform?
q3.resposta: All former students of UFLA can register, regardless of course or year of graduation. The platform is aimed at both graduates and postgraduates of the institution.

q4.pergunta: Is there a cost to register on the PLAEG alumni platform?
q4.resposta: No, registration is completely free. In addition, there are benefits for alumni registered on the PLAEG alumni platform (see question "What benefits will I have by registering on the PLAEG alumni platform?").

q5.pergunta: What benefits will I get from registering?
q5.resposta: By registering on the PLAEG alumni platform, you can have access to various benefits, such as events and training courses, networking with other alumni, an email account @alumni.ufla.br, access to UFLA Library's virtual collection, to the Google application suite (Google Workspace), and to UFLA's Wi-Fi network.

q6.pergunta: How often do I need to update my registration?
q6.resposta: There is no mandatory frequency, but we recommend that you review your information whenever there are significant changes, such as a job change, completion of a new course, or updating contact details. Keeping your registration updated is important so that UFLA can offer content and opportunities aligned with your professional profile.

q7.pergunta: Does the PLAEG platform offer networking opportunities for alumni?
q7.resposta: Yes! The platform allows an alumnus to search for information about their classmates, which can help in creating a valuable contact network for exchanging experiences, referrals, and job market opportunities.

q8.pergunta: Is there any means of contact in case I have questions or problems with my registration?
q8.resposta: Yes! If you have any questions or issues, you can contact the Alumni Advisory of the Pro-Rectory of Extension, Sports, and Culture (PROEEC) via email at egressos.proeec@ufla.br or by phone at (35) 3829-1212.
